outcome: Concentrations of β-casein, α-lactalbumin, lactoferrin, serum albumin, and κ-casein in breast milk
cohort: 55 mothers from three cities in China (Hohhot, Wuhan, and Qingdao)
finding: This study found that maternal age, delivery mode, infant gender, and geographical location influenced the concentration of specific proteins in breast milk in a Chinese population.
mod_finding: Caesarean section was associated with lower concentrations of κ-casein, lactoferrin, and β-casein in mature milk compared with vaginal delivery.
birth_weight: Measured, but specific values not reported
